Os 9 pinos têm a numeração, os nomes e as posições (x,y em % da imagem) pedidas
expr: (()=>{const E=["Entrada","Recepção / Restaurante","Casa principal","Piscina","Espaço de eventos","Círculo do fogo / Fogueira","Bar piscina","Jardim","Fogueira"].map((n,i)=>[i+1,n,...[[70,6],[47,90],[14,90],[30,27],[88,27],[91,80],[6,62],[62,88],[64,45]][i]]);const m=document.querySelector('#page-home .atlas-map').getBoundingClientRect();const P=[...document.querySelectorAll('#page-home .atlas-home-card .map-pin')];return P.length===9&&E.every(([n,pl,x,y])=>{const b=P.find(p=>p.textContent.trim()==String(n));if(!b||b.dataset.place!==pl)return false;const r=b.getBoundingClientRect();const px=((r.left+r.right)/2-m.left)/m.width*100,py=((r.top+r.bottom)/2-m.top)/m.height*100;return Math.abs(px-x)<.7&&Math.abs(py-y)<.7})})()

item: Remover o espaço 10 "Área complementar" (da Home)
Os pinos chamam CDL.selectHomeAtlas(place) e o texto do cartão acompanha o pino (testado nos pinos 6 e 8)
expr: (()=>{let calls=[];const o=CDL.selectHomeAtlas;CDL.selectHomeAtlas=p=>{calls.push(p);return o&&o(p)};const b6=[...document.querySelectorAll('#page-home .map-pin')].find(b=>b.textContent==='6');b6.click();const a=document.getElementById('homeAtlasTitle').textContent==='Círculo do fogo / Fogueira'&&/círculo reúne conversa/.test(document.getElementById('homeAtlasText').textContent)&&b6.classList.contains('active');const b8=[...document.querySelectorAll('#page-home .map-pin')].find(b=>b.textContent==='8');b8.click();const c=document.getElementById('homeAtlasTitle').textContent==='Jardim'&&/lado de fora/.test(document.getElementById('homeAtlasText').textContent);CDL.selectHomeAtlas=o;return a&&c&&calls.join('|')==='Círculo do fogo / Fogueira|Jardim'})()

item: abas "Com amigos" e "Para um encontro": linhas do texto equilibradas
expr: (async()=>{const ok=[];for(const k of ['amigos','encontro']){document.querySelector('[data-profile='+k+']').click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200));ok.push((()=>{const ps=[...document.querySelectorAll("#profileText")].filter(e=>e.getBoundingClientRect().height>0);if(!ps.length)return false;return ps.every(p=>{const w=document.createTreeWalker(p,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);let t;const L={};while((t=w.nextNode())){const re=/\S+/g;let m;while((m=re.exec(t.nodeValue))){const r=document.createRange();r.setStart(t,m.index);r.setEnd(t,m.index+m[0].length);const b=r.getBoundingClientRect();const k=Object.keys(L).find(y=>Math.abs(y-b.top)<5)??b.top;(L[k]||={l:1e9,r:-1e9});L[k].l=Math.min(L[k].l,b.left);L[k].r=Math.max(L[k].r,b.right);}}const ws=Object.values(L).map(x=>x.r-x.l);return ws.length<2||Math.min(...ws)/Math.max(...ws)>=.74})})())}document.querySelector('[data-profile=familia]').click();return ok.every(Boolean)})()
